title: 第十五章 战意沸腾外门第一到手第十六章 执法殿魂审自保反杀定案
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
【天赋已刷新！】
【本周天赋：战意沸腾】
【注：战斗中意志越盛，灵力恢复越快，肉身承受越强。濒临极限时，有概率破境。】
周荒看着系统提示，眼神一点点亮起。
百倍悟性让他学会如何打。
战意沸腾，像是专门为接下来的决赛准备的。
半个时辰后，最终战开始。
周荒对韩无极。
一个刚入外门不到十日的新人。
一个霸占外门第一整整两年的老牌强者。
擂台四周挤满了人。
韩无极缓缓起身，白衣无尘，手中提着一柄银色长剑。
炼气九层的气息一放，整个擂台都像冷了几分。
周荒没有立刻拔剑。
他先扫了一眼高台。
柳红绡在看他，沈青禾在看他，顾清寒也在看他。
台下还有无数外门弟子。
这一战若输，他仍是前十，却会被韩无极压回“侥幸”的位置。
若赢，他才是真正的外门第一。
更何况，柳红绡还在台上等着。

周荒摸了摸怀里的合欢令。
这不是争名。
这是争命。
“周荒。”
韩无极声音平静。
“你能走到这里，确实出乎我意料。认输吧，我可以让你保住前十名额。”
周荒笑了。
“韩师兄这是怕了？”
台下一片哗然。
韩无极眼神淡下来。
“不知死活。”
裁判宣布开始。
银剑出鞘。
周荒甚至没看清韩无极动作，寒光已到眼前。
太快！
他御风步猛然展开，仍被剑气擦过胸口，外门弟子服瞬间裂开，皮肤渗出血线。
韩无极一剑得手，没有停顿，第二剑、第三剑接连斩来。
他的剑法没有多余变化。
快，准，冷。
content_en:
[Talent has been refreshed! 】
[Talent of the week: Fighting spirit]
[Note: The stronger your will is during battle, the faster your spiritual power will recover, and the stronger your physical body will endure. When approaching the limit, there is a chance of breaking through. 】
Zhou Huang looked at the system prompts and his eyes lit up little by little.
A hundred times more understanding allowed him to learn how to fight.
The fighting spirit was boiling, as if he was specially prepared for the next finals.
Half an hour later, the final battle began.
Zhou Huang versus Han Wuji.
A newcomer who has just entered the outer sect less than ten days ago.
A veteran strongman who has occupied the first place in the outer sect for two full years.
The ring was crowded with people.
Han Wuji slowly stood up, dressed in white clothes and holding a silver sword in his hand.
As soon as the breath of the ninth level of Qi Refining was released, the whole arena seemed to be a little colder.
Zhou Huang did not draw his sword immediately.
He glanced at the high platform first.
Liu Hongxiao was looking at him, Shen Qinghe was looking at him, and Gu Qinghan was also looking at him.
There are countless outer disciples in the audience.
If he loses this battle, he will still be in the top ten, but he will be pushed back to the "lucky" position by Han Wuji.
If he wins, he will be the real number one in the outer sect.
What's more, Liu Hongxiao is still waiting on the stage.
Zhou Huang touched the Acacia Ling in his arms.
This is not a fight for fame.
This is a fight for life.
"Zhou Huang."
Han Wuji's voice was calm.
"It's really beyond my expectation that you can get here. Give up, I can keep you in the top ten."
Zhou Huang smiled.
"Senior Brother Han, are you afraid?"
The audience was in an uproar.
Han Wuji's eyes dimmed.
"I don't know whether to live or die."
The referee announced the start.
The silver sword is unsheathed.
Zhou Huang didn't even see Han Wuji's movements clearly, the cold light was already in front of him.
Too fast!
He suddenly unfolded his wind-controlling steps, but was still brushed against his chest by the sword energy. The outer disciple's uniform split instantly, and blood oozed from his skin.
Han Wuji succeeded with one sword, and without any pause, he struck with the second and third swords one after another.
There are no unnecessary changes in his swordsmanship.
Fast, accurate and cold.
